channel.title: Happy Day News
channel.description: Happy Day News is a daily positive news podcast — your morning dose of good news from around the world, in under 3 minutes. Every day: scientific breakthroughs, environmental wins, acts of kindness, and community achievements that actually happened. No negativity, no doom, no clickbait — just real progress and people doing good. Start your day feeling hopeful. Search Happy Day News wherever you get your podcasts.
